# Diana Barry

## Appearance

Diana is a very pretty girl who has jet-black, glossy tresses and black eyes inherited from her mother. She is also characterized by her rosy cheeks and a merry expression.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P21](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P22](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0022), [v1 CHAPTER XVII. A New Interest in Life P10](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0010)_

## Personality

Diana is a smart, good, and ladylike individual who carries a merry expression inherited from her father. She possesses talent as a singer, selected to perform solos, and is widely known for her exceptional taste in dressing.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER VIII. Anne’s Bringing-up Is Begun P40](../source/v01-c08.md#nw-v01-c08-p0040), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## History

Diana Barry was named by a schoolmaster who boarded with her family at the time of her birth. When [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) moved to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she and Diana met at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope) and instantly pledged to be lifelong bosom friends. Their friendship faced a brief separation when Diana's mother forbade her from playing with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), forcing the two girls to secretly exchange notes at school. However, after [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) successfully saved Diana's sick sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md) from severe croup, Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) lifted the ban and allowed their friendship to resume. Over the years, Diana remained a constant support to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), forming a story club with her, bringing her the exciting news that she tied for first place on the Queen's [Entrance](../codex/places.md#entrance) examination, and helping her dress for a high-profile benefit concert at the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER II. Matthew Cuthbert Is Surprised P64](../source/v01-c02.md#nw-v01-c02-p0064), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XII. ## Quotes

> "I’m awfully glad you’ve come to live at Green Gables. It will be jolly to have somebody to play with. There isn’t any other girl who lives near enough to play with, and I’ve no sisters big enough."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P27](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0027)

> "Why, he makes fun of all the girls. He laughs at mine because it’s so black. He’s called me a crow a dozen times; and I never heard him apologize for anything before, either."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053)

> "I do think you’re mean. What shall I do? Mr. Phillips will make me sit with that horrid Gertie Pye—I know he will because she is sitting alone. Do come back, Anne."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P74](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0074)

> “I don’t believe he’ll find the doctor at Carmody,” sobbed Diana. “I know that Dr. Blair went to town and I guess Dr. Spencer would go too. Young Mary Joe never saw anybody with croup and Mrs. Lynde is away. Oh, Anne!”
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XVIII. Anne to the Rescue P24](../source/v01-c18.md#nw-v01-c18-p0024)

> "I guess we must have made as much as ten dollars. Mind you, Mr. Allan is going to send an account of it to the Charlottetown papers."
>
> — Diana Barry — [v1 CHAPTER XXV. Matthew Insists on Puffed Sleeves P49](../source/v01-c25.md#nw-v01-c25-p0049)

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--diana-barry.md)

Diana and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly form a deep connection after being introduced at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope), pledging a solemn oath to be bosom friends forever. They share childhood adventures, such as rowing together on the pond and attending school together. Even when challenges arise—such as Mrs. [Barry](../character/barry.md) temporarily forbidding their interaction or [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) saving Diana's sister [Minnie May](../character/minnie-may.md)—their friendship remains steadfast and deeply emotional.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P8](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0008), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P25](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0025), [v1 CHAPTER XII. A Solemn Vow and Promise P35](../source/v01-c12.md#nw-v01-c12-p0035), +45 more_

### [Barry](../character/barry.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/barry--diana-barry.md)

Diana is the daughter of Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md) and resides with her family at [Orchard Slope](../codex/places.md#orchard-slope). Her father's home serves as a hub for their social gatherings, including hosting parties for Diana and her friends.

### [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/diana-barry--gilbert-blythe.md)

Diana acts as a friendly classmate to [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), keeping track of his affairs at school and acting as a peacemaker between him and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). She informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) of Gilbert's return to school, supports [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) through their intense academic rivalries, and accompanies [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to events where [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) is present.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P16](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0016), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P38](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0038), +14 more_
